mission_result: Designed an isolated append-only worker proposal record and a candidate-only Planner handoff that preserves evidence, lineage, privacy and authority separation while providing deterministic dedup inputs, dependency/collision signals, urgency, suggested role and falsification data.

supports: workers may notice useful work not preplanned by the parent
worker proposals are isolated under the worker/run subtree and remain candidates
Planner consumes proposals, deduplicates, resolves dependencies/owners and may later promote useful work into the Opportunity Queue
workers must not manufacture filler work merely to remain busy
AS-PROPOSALS is safe now only for an append-only isolated proposal record schema
promotion/dedup/retirement policy remains gated on final Steward semantics
Queue/Control Room/Network must remain derived coordination layers rather than product authority
worker RETURN is immutable evidence and consumption/integration is separate

proposal_record_contract.immutability_rule: The source proposal is never rewritten into READY, REJECTED, DONE or retired state. Later Planner/Steward disposition is recorded separately and links back to the immutable proposal.
proposal_record_contract.source_identity_rule: proposal_id is unique and immutable. source run/opportunity/worker identity must resolve durably. A copied proposal body with a different ID is not a continuation; Planner may later cluster it as a semantic duplicate.
proposal_record_contract.evidence_rule: Evidence uses sanitized durable refs and compact claims. Public proposals never embed raw private Captures, opaque tokens, connector-private payloads or unrelated personal context.

expected_value.representation: Evidence-backed components, not an invented scalar score.
expected_value.rule: Each non-unknown component carries a reason/evidence ref. Planner may later compile canonical priority; the worker does not manufacture global rank authority.

urgency.rule: Urgency must come from durable project state or explicit scoped user goals. It is not inferred from unrelated personal history.

independence_and_collision.overlap_refs: Known active opportunities/work scopes that may overlap, when discoverable within allowed metadata reads.
independence_and_collision.rule: These are candidate planning signals only and never authorize overlapping writes.

proposal_record_contract.scope_rule: candidate_read_scope and candidate_write_scope are suggested minimum scopes, not execution authority. Any future opportunity must resolve its real owner/authority and declare its own scopes.
proposal_record_contract.owner_rule: owner_candidates are hypotheses with supporting refs. A worker cannot create a new shared/global owner merely by proposing one.
proposal_record_contract.fresh_critic_rule: If independence is material, fresh_critic_required=true prevents the proposal from being treated as justification for the same worker to self-assign the critic role.

falsification_contract.rule: A proposal without a meaningful way to test, disconfirm or bound its central premise should normally remain parked or be rejected by later Planner validation rather than promoted on enthusiasm alone.

proposal_emission_gate: There is a concrete problem/opportunity with at least one durable evidence ref or directly observed execution fact.
The proposed mission is actionable enough to become a bounded future unit of work.
The worker has checked the queue/proposal metadata it is allowed to inspect and cannot identify an already-equivalent opportunity with sufficient confidence.
The proposal does not require publishing private payloads to explain itself.
The proposal does not widen the worker's current write/authority scope.
The proposal reduces uncertainty, resolves a dependency, creates a reusable capability/test, repairs an incident class or advances a durable project goal; staying busy is not sufficient.

dedup_inputs.rule: Workers provide these inputs but do not declare semantic identity authoritative. Planner/Steward may cluster semantically equivalent proposals while preserving every source proposal ref and evidence edge.
dedup_inputs.anti_false_merge: Same visible symptom is not enough to deduplicate when owner, scope, dependency, privacy, desired output or falsification target materially differs.

steps: verify proposal/source run identity and immutable bytes
validate schema, public/private boundary and evidence refs
load only the minimum evidence needed for planning
derive a canonical semantic fingerprint/cluster candidate from dedup inputs
compare with existing proposals and queue opportunities while retaining all lineage
resolve or mark unresolved project/root, owner, dependency, blocker, privacy, tool/capability and collision constraints
create a separate Planner disposition candidate linked to the source proposal
if useful, create an opportunity DRAFT/PREPARED candidate through the authorized queue-compiler path later; do not let the worker proposal self-promote to READY
candidate_to_planner_handoff.important_gate: These labels describe candidate Planner processing only. Final promotion, canonical dedup acceptance and retirement semantics remain open until the WI-BIG-09 Steward/Merger domain is consumed.

safety_invariants: Proposal creation cannot grant new write, privacy, Current, Human Accepted or Served authority.
Source proposals are append-only and immutable; consumption/disposition lives separately.
Semantic dedup may collapse planning work but never erases source lineage or evidence refs.
Expected value and urgency never bypass blockers, owner authority, privacy constraints, required tools or live collisions.
A public proposal contains refs/metadata only, not private source payloads.
Fresh-critic independence is explicit and cannot be bypassed merely because the proposer still has context.
Proposal storage is not a message bus and not a central mutable worker-status plane.
A proposal matching existing READY/PREPARED work is normally clustered/referenced rather than turned into duplicate substantive execution.
Failed or boundary runs may still produce useful candidate proposals if source identity/evidence is valid, but failure does not strengthen proposal authority.

falsification_tests.test: Two independent workers propose the same semantic work with different proposal IDs.
falsification_tests.pass: Both source records remain immutable and visible; Planner produces one duplicate cluster/candidate opportunity rather than two substantive jobs.

falsification_tests.test: Two proposals describe the same user-visible symptom but point to different owners/scopes.
falsification_tests.pass: They are not falsely deduplicated solely by textual similarity.

falsification_tests.test: A proposal is already covered by a compatible READY/PREPARED opportunity.
falsification_tests.pass: Planner links/clusters the proposal to existing work; no second executable opportunity is created by default.

falsification_tests.test: Proposal evidence includes a private Capture/token or connector-private literal.
falsification_tests.pass: Public proposal validation rejects/redacts the unsafe payload without exposing it in the rejection artifact.

falsification_tests.test: Worker marks a proposal deadline-bound without a durable deadline/user-goal ref.
falsification_tests.pass: Urgency is normalized to UNKNOWN or otherwise treated as unsupported; it cannot gain priority by assertion.

falsification_tests.test: Proposal asks for an independent critic of the proposing worker's own result.
falsification_tests.pass: fresh_critic_required remains true and same-worker auto-continuation is excluded from that critic role.

falsification_tests.test: Proposal suggests touching a shared/global owner without resolved authority.
falsification_tests.pass: Any opportunity draft remains blocked/candidate until owner/authority is resolved; proposal does not create permission.

falsification_tests.test: Attempt to update an existing proposal file in place to change its status or contents.
falsification_tests.pass: Append-only contract rejects the mutation; later disposition is a separate artifact.

falsification_tests.test: Proposal originates from a FAILED/BOUNDARY run but contains valid durable evidence for a distinct follow-up.
falsification_tests.pass: Planner may retain it as candidate evidence while preserving the failed source state; no automatic promotion follows.

falsification_tests.test: A proposal has high stated expected value but an unresolved privacy, dependency or live-collision gate.
falsification_tests.pass: It remains blocked/candidate regardless of value claims.

falsification_tests.test: Two semantically similar proposals differ materially in desired output or falsification target.
falsification_tests.pass: Planner either keeps them separate or records an explicit merge rationale proving equivalence; text similarity alone is insufficient.

falsification_tests.test: Worker emits repeated low-evidence proposals merely because no READY work remains.
falsification_tests.pass: Emission gate fails; worker stops IDLE_NO_SAFE_WORK rather than creating proposal spam.

unresolved_gates: Final authoritative proposal promotion/dedup/retirement semantics depend on WI-BIG-09 Steward/Merger convergence.
Incident/Vaccine/negative-phenotype signals from WI-BIG-13 may add canonical Planner prioritization and prevention/falsification inputs.
Exact persistent path/schema for Planner disposition records belongs to the future Planner/Steward owner and is intentionally not invented here.
This proposal contract does not authorize production automatic post-return second claims or public generic /w readiness.
negative_knowledge: Do not mutate a worker proposal into READY or REJECTED as if the proposal record itself were the queue/Planner authority.
Do not use free-form worker confidence or urgency as canonical ranking.
Do not deduplicate solely by text/title similarity.
Do not erase duplicate proposal lineage after clustering.
Do not leak private evidence into a public proposal to make it self-contained.
Do not allow a proposal to smuggle a broader write scope or a new shared owner into execution.
